_comment: Append-only. One object per closed trade. Never back-filled: no trade with entry_date earlier than opened_utc may be inserted. Entries additionally require volume>0 on the entry bar and >=18 of the trailing 20 sessions traded.

schema.ihsg_regime_at_entry: BULL | BEAR | SIDEWAYS | null — engine.regime_filter.detect_regime on IHSG at the entry session. OBSERVABILITY ONLY: never filters, gates or sizes anything; every signal the frozen spec emits is recorded regardless of regime, and the section 3 endpoint is computed over all of them. Fail-soft: null on classifier error.
schema.ihsg_weekly_regime_at_entry: BULL | BEAR | SIDEWAYS | null — detect_regime on WEEKLY IHSG bars (W-FRI), taken from the last week CLOSED strictly before the entry date (an entry mid-week cannot see the in-progress bar). OBSERVABILITY ONLY, same terms as the daily field.
